snippet.title: Miniature Mania - Early Access First Look
snippet.description:
After a lot of hard work, we’re happy to show you a first look at our new game: Miniature Mania! A miniature painting simulator, letting you paint and experiment in VR/MR without the pressure of messing up your first real-life model!

Coming soon in Early Access (Free):
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421460/Miniature_Mania
- Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/miniature-mania/8982057661883517

We’d love to hear what you think over at our discord while we continue development: https://discord.gg/rfZpvdmzMq

"Study And Relax" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
